config.manuscript: A Swahili Sign Language Recognition Using Bidirectional LSTM with Temporal Attention (JCTA revision)

normalization.description: min/max per coordinate dimension over all non-padded frames of the training split only; constants are fixed and released with the model

split.order: split first, then augment the training partition only

training.class_weighting: Imbalance ratio in the augmented training partition is 1.0120. Class weighting is DISABLED because it would be a no-op. The manuscript should state that the balanced factorial design survives the stratified split, so inverse-frequency weighting was not required.

n_clips_retained.note: Section 3.2.4: clips passing the 90% landmark-quality threshold

pct_clips_padded.note: Section 3.3: share of clips shorter than the 60-frame window

mean_live_frames.note: Section 3.3: mean number of real (non-padded) frames per standardized sequence

test_per_class.note: Figure 6 caption: test samples per class

train_imbalance_ratio.note: Section 3.6 / Eq. (15): whether class weighting is justified

proposed_best_epoch.note: Figure 4 caption: the epoch at which early stopping restored the best weights

proposed_train_val_gap_pp.note: Section 4.2: the train-validation gap behind the regularization claim

expected_calibration_error.note: Section 4.7.2: whether the confidence threshold in Algorithm 1 is trustworthy

n_baselines_significantly_beaten.note: Section 4.3: how many baselines the proposed model separates from at p<0.05

delta_full_face_pp.note: Section 3.2.6 (A10): measured effect of adding the full 468-landmark face stream

delta_compact_face_pp.note: Section 3.2.6 (A10): measured effect of adding the compact 40-landmark face stream

release_dataset_mb.note: Data Availability Statement: size of the releasable landmark corpus

Full model (reference).purpose: All components active: 2-layer BiLSTM 128/64, additive temporal attention, batch normalization, dropout, L2, 258-d features, 7x augmentation.

Attention -> mean pooling.purpose: All frames weighted equally; stroke frames diluted by preparation and retraction.

Attention -> max pooling.purpose: Hard selection of one frame per feature rather than a soft distribution.

Attention -> last hidden state.purpose: Sequence compressed to its endpoint; equivalent to a plain BiLSTM.

Attention: Luong general score.purpose: e_t = q^T W h_t instead of the additive score of Eq. (11).

Attention: scaled dot product.purpose: e_t = (q . h_t)/sqrt(d); the cheapest scoring function.

Unidirectional (no backward pass).purpose: Frames lack the context of the retraction that follows them.

Single BiLSTM layer.purpose: One layer must map raw landmark geometry straight to a classifiable representation.

Three BiLSTM layers.purpose: Tests whether the corpus supports a third layer. Justifies stopping at two.

Narrower: 64/32 units.purpose: Half the published width. Justifies the 128/64 choice from below.

Wider: 256/128 units.purpose: Double the published width. Justifies the 128/64 choice from above.

No batch normalization.purpose: Slower, noisier convergence of recurrent activations.

No dropout.purpose: Isolates the contribution of the dropout schedule in Table 6.

No L2 penalty.purpose: Isolates the contribution of the 1e-3 weight decay in Table 6.

Hands only (126-d).purpose: Removes torso and arm trajectory context; keeps handshape and finger configuration.

Pose only (132-d).purpose: Removes handshape entirely; keeps body posture and gross arm trajectory.

Plus full face (1662-d).purpose: REVIEWER A COMMENT 10. Adds all 468 MediaPipe face landmarks. Measures whether the non-manual channel helps on this vocabulary, instead of arguing the exclusion on parameter-budget grounds.

Plus compact face (378-d).purpose: REVIEWER A COMMENT 10. Adds 40 selected lip, brow, eye and outline landmarks: the non-manual information at a fraction of the cost, so the face question is separated from the dimensionality question.

Normalization: per_sequence.purpose: REVIEWER B COMMENT 6. Same model, normalization scope changed to per_sequence. Justifies the default empirically.

Normalization: per_frame.purpose: REVIEWER B COMMENT 6. Same model, normalization scope changed to per_frame. Justifies the default empirically.

Normalization: body_anchored.purpose: REVIEWER B COMMENT 6. Same model, normalization scope changed to body_anchored. Justifies the default empirically.

Length: uniform resampling, not padding.purpose: Every clip is resampled onto exactly T frames instead of being zero-padded or truncated, so the window carries no padding at all. The alternative to the published pad/truncate scheme, and the one that matters most if the corpus is mostly padding.

No data augmentation.purpose: Trains on the 585 original training clips only. The single largest component in a corpus of this size.
